members.body:
# Tokenizer

The scanner walks the source once, emitting (kind, value) pairs. Quoted
runs are emitted as a single VALUE token with the quotes stripped.

An unterminated quote raises rather than returning what it has. Returning
a partial token list here would push the failure to a caller that has no
way to tell a truncated query from a short one.

aspects.claim: an unterminated quote raises instead of returning a partial token list
